text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...The truth is, I wanted to get<n>something more
personal and<n>special—something only I could
provide.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Like an epic saga starring a hero that<n>resembles
you, or a cutting-edge<n>training manual, or a
photobook of<n>American landscapes...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
B-but... the more I thought it over, the<n>harder it was
to find the right answer!<n>In the end—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
This weight. The sound of the water.<n>You picked my
favorite kind, didn't<n>you?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Yes. I heard that you were very<n>particular about
water.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So I tried to pick something close to<n>what you
always drink...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad. I'm sure it's delicious.<n>Thank you, Rob
Roy.
